race.comment: JUNGLE WONDER (3) just ran into one better at Rockhampton last time out and looks to be improving with racing. Cartwright was in the irons for that last-start placing and sticks here. Rates the testing material against this line-up. FARNANHEIT (2) is having his first run for the new stable but should find this easier than what he faced in the southern states. Tuned up for this with a recent trial and can run a big race while fresh. BOOM BUNNY (6) has placed five of eight over this track and trip and maps ideally for this from gate two. Genuine top-three candidate. SENSEI GIRL (8) was a touch plain last time out but the form prior was full of merit. Worth another chance. WATEGO'S BAY (11) next in line on the back of a solid second at Cairns on debut.
